messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up from the postmortem thread  we need owners and short ETAs for the recurring streaming issues (timeouts, silent partials, reconnect storms). I'll collect into the retro packet.

roshan: I'll own reconnect policy + SDK defaults. Intent: define a safe exponential backoff + jitter, set SDK max-retries=3, and publish example code. ETA: Mon EOD. Ticket RW-5021.

amy: I'll take the "silent partials" detector. Plan: add inter-chunk-gap p95 metric, event when gap>8s without error, and dashboard tiles. ETA: Wed AM. Ticket RW-5022.

kevin: I'll handle server-side protections: soft circuit breaker on session write failures, and graceful cache eviction window. Will also add a deploy-time health check that inspects partial-gap rate on canaries. ETA: Thu EOD. Ticket RW-5023.

ops-bot: Ticket RW-5021 created by roshan. Link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/RW-5021
ops-bot: Ticket RW-5022 created by amy. Link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/RW-5022
ops-bot: Ticket RW-5023 created by kevin. Link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/RW-5023

elaine: Short fast-remediations we can do this week: raise heartbeat frequency from 20s->12s for affected fleets, enable transient replication for hot KV ranges, and add a temporary routing fallback to non-streaming endpoints for premium customers. Who'll own each?

amy: I'll validate telemetry impact of increased heartbeat and the new metric ingestion. Need observability quota bump. Can someone file that?

roshan: devex will own SDK sample changes (I'll draft). Kevin can own server toggles for replication and routing fallback.

kevin: I'll own replication toggle + routing fallback config. Will coordinate with infra and SRE. ETA for toggle: Tue morning. Ticket RW-5024 (will open).

elaine: Great. Can each owner add a one-line impact estimate to their ticket so I can summarize for leadership? e.g., "expected to reduce partial-stream incidents by X% in canary".

amy: One-line: "exposes silent gaps and enables automated aborts during rollout; estimated detection coverage +40% on initial deploys."

roshan: One-line: "SDK jitter + capped retries reduces reconnect storms and evens load on servers."

kevin: One-line: "soft circuit breaker and eviction window expected to reduce tail inter-chunk gaps under memory pressure."

elaine: OK checklist for retro update: 
- SDK reconnect defaults: roshan  RW-5021  Mon EOD
- Partial-gap metric & detector: amy  RW-5022  Wed AM
- Circuit-breaker + eviction window: kevin  RW-5023  Thu EOD
- Replication toggle (fast rem): kevin  RW-5024  Tue AM
- Observability quota request: elaine  RW-5025  Today

roshan: :white_check_mark: I'll add SDK snippets to RW-5021 and ping devex for review.

amy: :white_check_mark: I'll open RW-5022 PR for metric proto and schedule a pair with infra for quota.

kevin: :white_check_mark: will open RW-5024 and schedule infra sync for replication toggle.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2765432101 in 3 days.

elaine: Thanks team. Post any slips or quick blockers here and I'll keep the retro summary updated.
